Diagnosis: set_key (main.py:184-185) escapes only apostrophes when single-quoting, leaving backslashes literal. The parser's single-quote regex/decoder treats `\\` and `\'` as escapes, so values containing backslashes (especially before a quote or doubled) are misparsed and don't round-trip.

Plan: escape backslashes before apostrophes in the quoted branch (`value_to_set.replace("\\","\\\\").replace("'","\\'")`), matching the parser's `_single_quote_escapes` set. Keep quote_mode selection and export behavior unchanged. Add round-trip tests covering consecutive backslashes and apostrophes via dotenv_values(interpolate=False).
